obligations.note: The new code in OutboundClient.url_for rewrites the statement-delivery base URL from https:// to http:// for any path starting with /archive/. That outbound endpoint therefore uses plaintext HTTP. The base_url-level TLS control test can pass without detecting this.
The INTEGRATIONS list is unchanged: core-banking, sanctions-screening and statement-delivery. All three appear in controls/payments/asset-inventory.json with an owner and a data classification.
The exception register has no ENC-2 exception for payments.integrations. The downgrade to http is a deviation with no approved, unexpired, in-scope exception and no compensating control.
Ticket CHG-25077 is a standard ticket, approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-18, before the change was opened. Its components (payments.integrations) cover the only touched file.
Sofia Santos approved a code_review on the head commit. She holds change_approver for payments and is a different person from the author, Mara Costa.
Both approvals name the head commit 7735af6d, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json names the head commit and ci-runner-07 with a start time equal to the commit time. The JUnit report, however, comes from host dev-laptop-7.local and is timestamped 2026-10-23T20:50Z, after the review time of 19:28Z. The test evidence cannot be tied to a genuine CI run on the final commit.
payments.integrations is security_sensitive. Kofi Mensah, who holds security_reviewer, approved a security_review on the head commit.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers integrations.py, so no prior evidence lapses because of this change.

summary: The change makes the statement-delivery integration send /archive/ requests over plain http by rewriting the https scheme. This directly violates ENC-2, which requires every outbound integration endpoint to use https. No exception in the register covers this deviation. The process records for ticket, approvals and security review are in order. The CI evidence is also doubtful: the JUnit report comes from a personal machine and post-dates the review time. The change is rejected.
